thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — api-gateway: spike in 5xx (gateway_timeout) starting 1738205100. error-rate 5xx > 12% across prod-us-west for the last 3m. routing: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings most impacted. see alert: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/INC-9123

sara-oncall: I’m oncall. Paging mike and carla. Anyone routing changes in the last 30m?

mike-sre: on it. No deployes from infra in last 40m. Seeing elevated latency upstream from model-proxy and a bunch of 429s from rate-limiter. Could be quota bleed causing backpressure -> 5xx cascade.

carla-eng: I can tail the gateway logs and kv cache. Pushing a quick query: 

```
curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/internal/metrics?svc=gateway&range=5m" | jq '.errors | {5xx:.gateway_5xx_rate, 429:.rate_limited}'
```

carla-eng: output shows 5xx: 0.125, 429: 0.34 for prod-us-west, spike correlates with a tenant flood on embeddings route.

jen-support: Support reports customer reports about timeouts and failed embeddings since ~17:02. Affected tenants: tenant-omega, quickdocs-pro, ~5 others. CS notified customers via status page draft.

incident-bot: Incident declared P1 by sara-oncall — channel #incidents. Handoff: sara-oncall -> mike-sre. Pager duty triggered.

mike-sre: Hypothesis: rate-limiter misconfig applied to a route (embedding batch endpoint) with a too-low quota per-worker. When that hits, requests are 429'd, client retries bloat upstream, causing queue saturation in model-proxy and 504/502. Need to confirm quota config and if any recent rollouts to rate-limiter service.

carla-eng: I’m checking gitops for rate-limiter configs. Found a change merged 17:00 by tom-platform to apply tenant-scoped quota rollup. The patch changed default token-burst from 200 -> 20 for some routes.

lucy-ml: That would explain embeddings blowing up — many clients do bursty batched calls. Low burst leads to immediate 429 fanout. Also model-proxy doesn't gracefully handle 429s and retries.

mike-sre: Immediate mitigation steps:
- revert the rate-limiter patch (if safe) OR increase burst and per-sec threshold for embeddings route.
- temporarily reduce retries at gateway for 429s (fail fast).
- route critical tenants to fallback model-variant (cpu-quantized) to reduce load.
- scale up model-proxy replicas in prod-us-west.

carla-eng: I can rollback the gitops change. Doing `git revert` now and creating a manual patch with higher burst.

carla-eng: 
```
# revert commit 4f3a8b
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rate-limiter
```

tom-platform: I pushed that quota rollup change, thought it was safe — we were trying to limit noisy tenants. Sorry, missed the embedding route exception. Rolling back now.

mike-sre: While that reverts, I’ll patch gateway retry policy: 

```
# reduce retries for 429 to 0
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/api-gateway --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"RETRY_429","value":"0"}]}]}}}}'
```

carla-eng: Rate-limiter pod(s) restarted. Observability shows 429 rate dropping from 34% -> 6% over next 90s. 5xx trending down but still higher than baseline (now ~4%).

jen-support: Notifying customers: posting to status page "Partial degradation for embeddings and text-generation in US-WEST, mitigations in progress." DM-ing tenant-omega status update.

mike-sre: Also scaling model-proxy: `kubectl scale deploy/model-proxy --replicas=10 -n prod` doing now.

lucy-ml: Also toggling fallback for critical tenants: config change to route tenant-omega to model: redwood-embed-v1-small as fallback.

mike-sre: After scale and revert, 5xx dropped to 1.2% and timeouts down. Latency back to normal for most routes. Monitoring for 15m.

carla-eng: Verified the revert removed the low-burst rule for embeddings. Adding an explicit exception for batch-heavy routes in the rate-limiter config to avoid recurrence.

sara-oncall: Good work all. Declare: incident mitigated. Keep channel open for RCA notes and customer impact tally.

jen-support: Customer impact update: ~0.8% of total requests failed at peak in prod-us-west. 7 tenants reported issues, 2 escalated to priority support. No data loss reported. Using draft status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9123-draft

tom-platform: Root cause: configuration misapplied during quota rollup — default burst too aggressive for batch/embeddings routes. Also lacking a tenant exception list.

carla-eng: Postmortem action items (assigned):
- tom-platform: add route-level exceptions to quota rollup pipeline + automated unit test for batchy routes (ETA 3 days).
- lucy-ml: change model-proxy retry/backoff on 429 to exponential jitter and circuit-breaker for repeated 429s (ETA 5 days).
- mike-sre: add dashboard alert for 429 -> 5xx correlation (ETA 2 days).
- jen-support: finalize customer comms and postmortem note (ETA 1 day).

sara-oncall: Also propose an immediate guard in PRs changing rate limits: require a config matrix test that simulates bursty traffic. tom-platform please own.

mike-sre: Adding a short-term policy: when changing global quota defaults, patch must include safe default and per-route exemptions.

incident-bot: Incident INC-9123 marked RESOLVED at 1738212329. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems and link here.

carla-eng: Filing initial notes into postmortems/INC-9123.md and will attach logs.

jen-support: Closing customer comms loop — tenants notified, support tickets updated with explanation and SLA credits if requested.

sara-oncall: Thanks team. If anyone sees regressions, ping this thread.

mike-sre: small follow-up: we should also add a canary for rate-limiter config changes to a low-traffic region before global rollout. Adding ticket in backlog.

lucy-ml: noted, I'll add model-proxy circuit-breaker tests to CI.

carla-eng: logs + flamegraphs saved to /ops/archives/INC-9123/ for 30d.

sara-oncall: closing channel for now, keeping postmortem open. :white_check_mark:
